name: reynard
description: Reynard — a JavaScript Better Together gardener built with jco / ComponentizeJS.

scripts.fetch-wit: wkg get wasi:filesystem@0.2.3 --format wit -o wit/deps/ --overwrite && wkg get wasi:io@0.2.3 --format wit -o wit/deps/ --overwrite && wkg get wasi:clocks@0.2.3 --format wit -o wit/deps/ --overwrite
scripts.build: jco componentize component.js --wit wit --world-name reynard --disable http --disable fetch-event --out reynard.wasm && jco opt reynard.wasm -o reynard.wasm -- -Oz --all-features
